module.purpose: Provides the settings page for viewing and editing another team's profile within an organization, including profile publication, disbanding, preview, and membership-related actions.
module.summary: This client-side React page loads an organization's other team by route parameter, initializes an editable profile form, and renders either administrative controls or a read-only profile view. It coordinates team-update, publication, deletion, cache invalidation, navigation, analytics, clipboard, markdown conversion, avatar upload, and confirmation-dialog behavior.
module.businessContext: Supports organization administrators managing individual team profiles and lifecycle actions. Failures can prevent profile updates, publication, previews, or team disbanding.
functions: OtherTeamProfileView (~L53-356): Renders and manages another organization's team profile settings
refactorMeWithoutEffect (~L94-101): Redirects to the enterprise page when team loading fails
refactorMeWithoutEffect (~L103-114): Synchronizes fetched team data into the profile form
deleteTeam (~L155-157): Deletes the currently loaded team when an identifier exists
leaveTeam (~L159-165): Removes the current session user from the loaded team

concurrencyModel.notes: React effects and TRPC mutations are asynchronous; success callbacks await cache invalidation before subsequent notifications or navigation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The other-team query returns an error.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Prevents inaccessible or invalid team pages from remaining visible after a failed team lookup.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An administrator submits the profile after changing one or more fields.
moduleContractTests.then: The update payload contains the team id and excludes fields whose submitted values equal the existing team values.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the partial-update behavior and avoids overwriting unchanged profile data.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A user submits a slug containing characters other than ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens.
moduleContractTests.then: Validation fails with "Url can only have alphanumeric characters(a-z, 0-9) and hyphen(-) symbol."
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the URL character contract enforced before the team update mutation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An administrator confirms the disband-team dialog.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the destructive action payload and its team-list navigation flow.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Billing is enabled and the team has a requested slug while its current slug is null.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Protects the gated publication path for organization teams awaiting a requested slug.

preconditions: The component is rendered within providers and routing context required by its locale, router, session, form, and tRPC hooks.
postconditions: Returns null until team data is available.
Renders a loading skeleton while the team query is pending after team data is available.
Renders administrator profile controls, read-only team details, and the team disband action according to the loaded team state.

Profile updates submit only fields whose values differ from the loaded team's corresponding values.
A team error causes navigation to /enterprise.
Disbanding a team invalidates the other-team list, shows a success toast, navigates to the teams page, and tracks the disband action.
edgeCases: A missing or non-numeric route id disables the team query.
When no team data is present, the component returns null.
When the loaded team has a null slug and metadata.requestedSlug is present, the requested slug is used to populate the form slug.

When a team has no bio or its bio becomes empty after replacing


, read-only bio content is omitted.
When no loaded team id exists, the disband action does not invoke its mutation.
When no session data exists, the leave-team helper does not invoke its mutation.

detail.name: refactorMeWithoutEffect
postconditions: If teamError is truthy, router.replace is invoked with the /enterprise route.
If teamError is falsy, no redirect is initiated.
